text: Presentation by the Deputy Chief of Staff, Strategy and Integration, City Manager's Office regarding the implementation of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 473 (Streets and Sidewalks, Use of), Article XII (Access to Social Infrastructure).

The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee: 1. Recommended that the City Manager, in consultation with relevant City Divisions, consider enhancing the currently available public data related to Access Areas and provide updates monthly, that includes a map and searchable register of all Access Areas, and the following operational metrics for public review: a. Number of Access Area requests received, granted, denied, and withdrawn; b. Ward and type of social infrastructure institution (childcare centre, elementary, middle or high school, place of worship); c. Service requests, bylaw infractions, enforcement actions, and any associated police involvement; and d. Number and nature of complaints and resolutions related to Access Areas received by the City. 2.
